'''Bill Packer Emperor in the Clouds''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Bill Packer]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-15567">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15567 Emperor in the Clouds], DeckTech (Bill "Whipping Boy" packer, 24 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15567/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15567/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bill Packer]]
* '''Published:''' 24 April 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Emperor in the Clouds''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Twi'lek Advisor|JP-D-twilekadvisor.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Planetary Subjugation|SE-D-planetarysubjugation.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 EITC Packer DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Drain the clouds, control the city, lay waste to all who oppose

== Original post ==

'''Emperor in the Clouds'''
* '''Author:''' Bill "Whipping Boy" packer
* '''Published:''' April 24, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Drain the clouds, control the city, lay waste to all who oppose

=== Strategy ===

Drain the clouds, control cloud city. The impstars provide a punch (and 2 ability each) the scimitars, in association with planetary subjugation, make them 7 destinies (an Imp deck with 8 possible 7's) plenty of mains, go crazy
